preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns in the chess board must be between 3 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == n and all(len(line) == n for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output must consist of n lines, each containing n characters representing the placement of knights.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'WB' for line in stdout.splitlines() for c in line)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be either 'W' for white knight or 'B' for black knight.
The number of duels formed by the placement of knights must be the maximum possible.
